messages.content: Write COBOL to read a variable-length file and process records based on record type

Here's COBOL to process a variable-length file with multiple record types:

```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. VARLENGTH.
       
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INPUT-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
               FILE STATUS IS WS-FILE-STATUS.
       
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  INPUT-FILE
           RECORDING MODE IS V
           RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE
               FROM 10 TO 500
               DEPENDING ON WS-REC-LEN.
       01  INPUT-RECORD              PIC X(500).
       
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FILE-STATUS            PIC XX.
       01  WS-REC-LEN                PIC S9(4) COMP.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG               PIC X VALUE 'N'.
           88  END-OF-FILE           VALUE 'Y'.
       
       01  WS-COUNTERS.
           05  WS-HEADER-CNT         PIC 9(7) VALUE 0.
           05  WS-DETAIL-CNT         PIC 9(7) VALUE 0.
           05  WS-TRAILER-CNT        PIC 9(7) VALUE 0.
           05  WS-TOTAL-CNT          PIC 9(7) VALUE 0.
       
       01  HEADER-RECORD.
           05  HR-REC-TYPE           PIC X(2).
           05  HR-FILE-DATE          PIC X(8).
           05  HR-FILE-NAME          PIC X(20).
           05  FILLER                PIC X(470).
       
       01  DETAIL-RECORD.
           05  DR-REC-TYPE           PIC X(2).
           05  DR-CUST-ID            PIC X(10).
           05  DR-CUST-NAME          PIC X(30).
           05  DR-AMOUNT             PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05  DR-TRANS-DATE         PIC X(8).
           05  FILLER                PIC X(445).
       
       01  TRAILER-RECORD.
           05  TR-REC-TYPE           PIC X(2).
           05  TR-RECORD-COUNT       PIC 9(9).
           05  TR-TOTAL-AMOUNT       PIC S9(11)V99 COMP-3.
           05  FILLER                PIC X(481).
       
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZE
           PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-FILE
           PERFORM 3000-TERMINATE
           STOP RUN.
       
       1000-INITIALIZE.
           OPEN INPUT INPUT-FILE
           IF WS-FILE-STATUS NOT = '00'
               DISPLAY 'Error opening file: ' WS-FILE-STATUS
               MOVE 16 TO RETURN-CODE
               STOP RUN
           END-IF.
       
       2000-PROCESS-FILE.
           PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE
               READ INPUT-FILE
                   AT END SET END-OF-FILE TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END PERFORM 2100-PROCESS-RECORD
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM.
       
       2100-PROCESS-RECORD.
           ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-CNT
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN INPUT-RECORD(1:2) = 'HD'
                   MOVE INPUT-RECORD TO HEADER-RECORD
                   PERFORM 2200-PROCESS-HEADER
               WHEN INPUT-RECORD(1:2) = 'DT'
                   MOVE INPUT-RECORD TO DETAIL-RECORD
                   PERFORM 2300-PROCESS-DETAIL
               WHEN INPUT-RECORD(1:2) = 'TR'
                   MOVE INPUT-RECORD TO TRAILER-RECORD
                   PERFORM 2400-PROCESS-TRAILER
               WHEN OTHER
                   DISPLAY 'Unknown record type: ' 
                       INPUT-RECORD(1:2)
           END-EVALUATE.
       
       2200-PROCESS-HEADER.
           ADD 1 TO WS-HEADER-CNT
           DISPLAY 'Processing file: ' HR-FILE-NAME
           DISPLAY 'File date: ' HR-FILE-DATE.
       
       2300-PROCESS-DETAIL.
           ADD 1 TO WS-DETAIL-CNT
           DISPLAY 'Customer: ' DR-CUST-ID ' ' DR-CUST-NAME.
       
       2400-PROCESS-TRAILER.
           ADD 1 TO WS-TRAILER-CNT
           DISPLAY 'Expected count: ' TR-RECORD-COUNT
           DISPLAY 'Total amount: ' TR-TOTAL-AMOUNT.
       
       3000-TERMINATE.
           CLOSE INPUT-FILE
           DISPLAY 'Processing complete'
           DISPLAY 'Headers: ' WS-HEADER-CNT
           DISPLAY 'Details: ' WS-DETAIL-CNT
           DISPLAY 'Trailers: ' WS-TRAILER-CNT
           DISPLAY 'Total: ' WS-TOTAL-CNT.
```
Write COBOL to call a subprogram and pass parameters using LINKAGE SECTION

Here's a COBOL calling program and subprogram using LINKAGE SECTION:

**Calling Program (MAINPROG):**
```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. MAINPROG.
       
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-CUSTOMER-DATA.
           05  WS-CUST-ID            PIC X(10).
           05  WS-CUST-NAME          PIC X(30).
           05  WS-CUST-BALANCE       PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
       
       01  WS-RESULT-AREA.
           05  WS-RETURN-CODE        PIC S9(4) COMP.
           05  WS-MESSAGE            PIC X(50).
       
       01  WS-CONTROL-FLAGS.
           05  WS-FUNCTION-CODE      PIC X(2).
               88  FC-INQUIRY        VALUE 'IQ'.
               88  FC-UPDATE         VALUE 'UP'.
               88  FC-DELETE         VALUE 'DL'.
       
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZE
           PERFORM 2000-CALL-SUBPROGRAM
           PERFORM 3000-CHECK-RESULTS
           STOP RUN.
       
       1000-INITIALIZE.
           MOVE 'CUST000001' TO WS-CUST-ID
           MOVE 'IQ' TO WS-FUNCTION-CODE
           INITIALIZE WS-RESULT-AREA.
       
       2000-CALL-SUBPROGRAM.
           CALL 'CUSTPROG' USING WS-CONTROL-FLAGS
                                 WS-CUSTOMER-DATA
                                 WS-RESULT-AREA
           
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN WS-RETURN-CODE = 0
                   DISPLAY 'Call successful'
               WHEN WS-RETURN-CODE = 4
                   DISPLAY 'Warning: ' WS-MESSAGE
               WHEN OTHER
                   DISPLAY 'Error: ' WS-RETURN-CODE
                   DISPLAY 'Message: ' WS-MESSAGE
           END-EVALUATE.
       
       3000-CHECK-RESULTS.
           IF WS-RETURN-CODE = 0
               DISPLAY 'Customer: ' WS-CUST-NAME
               DISPLAY 'Balance: ' WS-CUST-BALANCE
           END-IF.
```

**Subprogram (CUSTPROG):**
```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CUSTPROG.
       
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-DB-STATUS             PIC XX.
       
       LINKAGE SECTION.
       01  LS-CONTROL-FLAGS.
           05  LS-FUNCTION-CODE     PIC X(2).
               88  FC-INQUIRY       VALUE 'IQ'.
               88  FC-UPDATE        VALUE 'UP'.
               88  FC-DELETE        VALUE 'DL'.
       
       01  LS-CUSTOMER-DATA.
           05  LS-CUST-ID           PIC X(10).
           05  LS-CUST-NAME         PIC X(30).
           05  LS-CUST-BALANCE      PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
       
       01  LS-RESULT-AREA.
           05  LS-RETURN-CODE       PIC S9(4) COMP.
           05  LS-MESSAGE           PIC X(50).
       
       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LS-CONTROL-FLAGS
                                LS-CUSTOMER-DATA
                                LS-RESULT-AREA.
           
           INITIALIZE LS-RESULT-AREA
           
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN FC-INQUIRY
                   PERFORM 1000-INQUIRY
               WHEN FC-UPDATE
                   PERFORM 2000-UPDATE
               WHEN FC-DELETE
                   PERFORM 3000-DELETE
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 12 TO LS-RETURN-CODE
                   MOVE 'Invalid function code' TO LS-MESSAGE
           END-EVALUATE
           
           GOBACK.
       
       1000-INQUIRY.
      *    Simulate database lookup
           MOVE 'JOHN SMITH' TO LS-CUST-NAME
           MOVE 1500.00 TO LS-CUST-BALANCE
           MOVE 0 TO LS-RETURN-CODE
           MOVE 'Inquiry successful' TO LS-MESSAGE.
       
       2000-UPDATE.
      *    Simulate database update
           MOVE 0 TO LS-RETURN-CODE
           MOVE 'Update successful' TO LS-MESSAGE.
       
       3000-DELETE.
      *    Simulate database delete
           MOVE 0 TO LS-RETURN-CODE
           MOVE 'Delete successful' TO LS-MESSAGE.
```

Key points:
- LINKAGE SECTION defines parameters received from caller
- PROCEDURE DIVISION USING lists parameters in order
- GOBACK returns to caller (not STOP RUN)
- Parameters are passed by reference (caller sees changes)
Write COBOL to use INSPECT to count and replace characters in a string

Here's COBOL demonstrating various INSPECT operations:

```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. INSPECTDEMO.
       
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-ORIGINAL-STRING       PIC X(50).
       01  WS-WORK-STRING           PIC X(50).
       01  WS-COUNT                 PIC 9(5).
       01  WS-COUNT-BEFORE          PIC 9(5).
       
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM 1000-COUNT-EXAMPLES
           PERFORM 2000-REPLACE-EXAMPLES
           PERFORM 3000-CONVERTING-EXAMPLES
           STOP RUN.
       
       1000-COUNT-EXAMPLES.
           DISPLAY '=== INSPECT TALLYING ===' 
           
      *    Count all spaces
           MOVE 'THE QUICK BROWN FOX JUMPS' TO WS-WORK-STRING
           MOVE 0 TO WS-COUNT
           INSPECT WS-WORK-STRING
               TALLYING WS-COUNT FOR ALL SPACES
           DISPLAY 'Spaces in string: ' WS-COUNT
           
      *    Count specific character
           MOVE 0 TO WS-COUNT
           INSPECT WS-WORK-STRING
               TALLYING WS-COUNT FOR ALL 'O'
           DISPLAY 'Letter O count: ' WS-COUNT
           
      *    Count leading zeros
           MOVE '000012345' TO WS-WORK-STRING
           MOVE 0 TO WS-COUNT
           INSPECT WS-WORK-STRING
               TALLYING WS-COUNT FOR LEADING '0'
           DISPLAY 'Leading zeros: ' WS-COUNT
           
      *    Count before first occurrence
           MOVE 'ABCDEFGHIJ' TO WS-WORK-STRING
           MOVE 0 TO WS-COUNT-BEFORE
           INSPECT WS-WORK-STRING
               TALLYING WS-COUNT-BEFORE FOR CHARACTERS 
                   BEFORE INITIAL 'E'
           DISPLAY 'Chars before E: ' WS-COUNT-BEFORE.
       
       2000-REPLACE-EXAMPLES.
           DISPLAY '=== INSPECT REPLACING ==='
           
      *    Replace all spaces with hyphens
           MOVE 'JOHN DOE SMITH' TO WS-WORK-STRING
           INSPECT WS-WORK-STRING
               REPLACING ALL SPACES BY '-'
           DISPLAY 'Spaces to hyphens: ' WS-WORK-STRING
           
      *    Replace leading zeros
           MOVE '00000123' TO WS-WORK-STRING
           INSPECT WS-WORK-STRING
               REPLACING LEADING '0' BY SPACE
           DISPLAY 'Remove leading zeros: [' WS-WORK-STRING ']'
           
      *    Replace first occurrence only
           MOVE 'BANANA' TO WS-WORK-STRING
           INSPECT WS-WORK-STRING
               REPLACING FIRST 'A' BY 'O'
           DISPLAY 'First A to O: ' WS-WORK-STRING
           
      *    Replace after specific position
           MOVE 'XXXX1234XXXX' TO WS-WORK-STRING
           INSPECT WS-WORK-STRING
               REPLACING ALL 'X' BY '*' 
                   AFTER INITIAL '4'
           DISPLAY 'Replace X after 4: ' WS-WORK-STRING.
       
       3000-CONVERTING-EXAMPLES.
           DISPLAY '=== INSPECT CONVERTING ==='
           
      *    Convert lowercase to uppercase
           MOVE 'Hello World' TO WS-WORK-STRING
           INSPECT WS-WORK-STRING
               CONVERTING 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
                       TO 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
           DISPLAY 'Uppercase: ' WS-WORK-STRING
           
      *    Convert digits to asterisks (mask)
           MOVE 'SSN: 123-45-6789' TO WS-WORK-STRING
           INSPECT WS-WORK-STRING
               CONVERTING '0123456789'
                       TO '**********'
           DISPLAY 'Masked SSN: ' WS-WORK-STRING
           
      *    Swap characters
           MOVE 'AABBCCDD' TO WS-WORK-STRING
           INSPECT WS-WORK-STRING
               CONVERTING 'ABCD'
                       TO 'DCBA'
           DISPLAY 'Swapped: ' WS-WORK-STRING.
```

INSPECT variations:
- TALLYING: Counts occurrences
- REPLACING: Changes characters
- CONVERTING: Maps character sets
- BEFORE/AFTER INITIAL: Position-relative operations
Write COBOL to use SEARCH and SEARCH ALL for table lookups

Here's COBOL demonstrating both SEARCH (sequential) and SEARCH ALL (binary):

```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SEARCHDEMO.
       
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
      *---------------------------------------------------------
      * Table for sequential SEARCH (doesn't need to be sorted)
      *---------------------------------------------------------
       01  STATE-TABLE.
           05  STATE-ENTRY OCCURS 5 TIMES
               INDEXED BY STATE-IDX.
               10  STATE-CODE      PIC XX.
               10  STATE-NAME      PIC X(15).
       
       01  STATE-VALUES.
           05  FILLER             PIC X(17) VALUE 'NYNEW YORK      '.
           05  FILLER             PIC X(17) VALUE 'CACALIFORNIA    '.
           05  FILLER             PIC X(17) VALUE 'TXCALIFORNIAXAS '.
           05  FILLER             PIC X(17) VALUE 'FLFLORIDA       '.
           05  FILLER             PIC X(17) VALUE 'ILILLOINOIS     '.
       
      *---------------------------------------------------------
      * Table for binary SEARCH ALL (MUST be sorted by key)
      *---------------------------------------------------------
       01  PRODUCT-TABLE.
           05  PRODUCT-ENTRY OCCURS 10 TIMES
               ASCENDING KEY IS PROD-CODE
               INDEXED BY PROD-IDX.
               10  PROD-CODE       PIC X(5).
               10  PROD-DESC       PIC X(20).
               10  PROD-PRICE      PIC 9(5)V99.
       
       01  WS-SEARCH-CODE          PIC XX.
       01  WS-SEARCH-PROD          PIC X(5).
       01  WS-FOUND-FLAG           PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZE
           PERFORM 2000-SEQUENTIAL-SEARCH
           PERFORM 3000-BINARY-SEARCH
           STOP RUN.
       
       1000-INITIALIZE.
      *    Load state table from values
           MOVE STATE-VALUES TO STATE-TABLE
           
      *    Load product table (must be sorted by PROD-CODE!)
           MOVE 'A0001WIDGET A           01000' TO PRODUCT-ENTRY(1)
           MOVE 'A0002WIDGET B           01500' TO PRODUCT-ENTRY(2)
           MOVE 'B0001GADGET BASIC       02000' TO PRODUCT-ENTRY(3)
           MOVE 'B0002GADGET PRO         03500' TO PRODUCT-ENTRY(4)
           MOVE 'C0001COMPONENT X        00500' TO PRODUCT-ENTRY(5)
           MOVE 'C0002COMPONENT Y        00750' TO PRODUCT-ENTRY(6)
           MOVE 'D0001DEVICE ALPHA       05000' TO PRODUCT-ENTRY(7)
           MOVE 'D0002DEVICE BETA        07500' TO PRODUCT-ENTRY(8)
           MOVE 'E0001EQUIPMENT 1        10000' TO PRODUCT-ENTRY(9)
           MOVE 'Z9999END OF TABLE       00000' TO PRODUCT-ENTRY(10).
       
       2000-SEQUENTIAL-SEARCH.
           DISPLAY '=== Sequential SEARCH ==='
           
           MOVE 'CA' TO WS-SEARCH-CODE
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FOUND-FLAG
           
           SET STATE-IDX TO 1
           SEARCH STATE-ENTRY
               AT END
                   DISPLAY 'State not found: ' WS-SEARCH-CODE
               WHEN STATE-CODE(STATE-IDX) = WS-SEARCH-CODE
                   MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FOUND-FLAG
                   DISPLAY 'Found: ' STATE-CODE(STATE-IDX)
                           ' = ' STATE-NAME(STATE-IDX)
           END-SEARCH
           
      *    Search for state not in table
           MOVE 'XX' TO WS-SEARCH-CODE
           SET STATE-IDX TO 1
           SEARCH STATE-ENTRY
               AT END
                   DISPLAY 'State not found: ' WS-SEARCH-CODE
               WHEN STATE-CODE(STATE-IDX) = WS-SEARCH-CODE
                   DISPLAY 'Found: ' STATE-NAME(STATE-IDX)
           END-SEARCH.
       
       3000-BINARY-SEARCH.
           DISPLAY '=== Binary SEARCH ALL ==='
           
           MOVE 'B0002' TO WS-SEARCH-PROD
           
           SEARCH ALL PRODUCT-ENTRY
               AT END
                   DISPLAY 'Product not found: ' WS-SEARCH-PROD
               WHEN PROD-CODE(PROD-IDX) = WS-SEARCH-PROD
                   DISPLAY 'Found: ' PROD-CODE(PROD-IDX)
                   DISPLAY '  Desc: ' PROD-DESC(PROD-IDX)
                   DISPLAY '  Price: ' PROD-PRICE(PROD-IDX)
           END-SEARCH
           
      *    Search for non-existent product
           MOVE 'X9999' TO WS-SEARCH-PROD
           SEARCH ALL PRODUCT-ENTRY
               AT END
                   DISPLAY 'Product not found: ' WS-SEARCH-PROD
               WHEN PROD-CODE(PROD-IDX) = WS-SEARCH-PROD
                   DISPLAY 'Found: ' PROD-DESC(PROD-IDX)
           END-SEARCH.
```

Key differences:
- **SEARCH**: Sequential, starts from current index, must SET index first
- **SEARCH ALL**: Binary search, requires ASCENDING/DESCENDING KEY, table must be sorted
- SEARCH ALL is faster for large tables (O(log n) vs O(n))
